record.intent: Test APK admission under the documented guest change and record the next observed startup boundary.
requirements: Use the selected scoped design and keep original and modified guest configurations distinctly identified.
No changes to Sparrow, model identity, calibration, native hardware interfaces, or physical devices.
Do not add further substitutions to progress beyond the first newly observed failure.
acceptance: Record guest modification source, hashes, reproducible application procedure, and rollback.
Verify exact APK preservation and run the specified negative controls against the admission exception.
Repeat the bounded install and startup attempt from clean modified-guest states.
Record UID and certificate behavior plus logs, process state, screenshot and crash evidence where reached.
Explain the result and recommend the next evidence-backed step without admitting successor work.
